purpose: Define per-metric tolerance bands for the Omega=1.0 mandate. Resolves V3 risk-hunter finding: continuous metrics cannot literally equal 1.0; without this file, testers will round (silent lies) or block forever.
interpretation: Omega=1.0 means: ALL discrete pass/fail gates GREEN AND ALL continuous metrics WITHIN published tolerance band below.
discreteGates: schemaVersion present on every state JSON
physics constants imported from src/physics/constants.ts (NOT inlined)
dispatcher action wired (lazy-import + Zod schema + action enum + dispatcher_map_compact entry)
test count >= 5 (1 happy + 3 failure modes + 2 adversarial inputs per always-build directive)
Cpk >= 1.33 on >=30 first-article parts spanning P/M/K/N/S/H ISO groups
G-code linter pass (zero warnings on shop_floor tier)

MAPE_quote.stat: mean absolute percentage error vs historical quotes; held-out from training

MAPE_cycle_time.stat: MAPE on rolling holdout, paired t-test p<0.05

MAE_lora_improvement.stat: mean absolute error reduction on customer-disjoint, time-ordered holdout

Sx_safety_score_shop_floor.stat: S(x) at shop_floor tier (five-sigma); see omega-thresholds.json

OEE.stat: live machine OEE per Grafana dashboard MS16

first_article_Cpk.stat: Cpk on critical dims, stratified by ISO group

min_per_dim_omega.stat: G_min_dim gate; geometric mean masking forbidden

thermal_cycle_friction_SF.stat: G_thermal_cycle gate: workholding SF at T_max with mu(T)=mu0*(1-0.003*dT)

passRule: Omega=1.0 IFF (every discrete gate GREEN) AND (every continuous metric meets target OR within [min, max] tolerance band) AND (n_min satisfied where specified)
blockRule: if any continuous metric exceeds max OR falls below min OR n_min unmet -> HARD BLOCK with named violation; emit ledger entry to SAFETY_GATE_LEDGER.jsonl with {ts, metric, observed, threshold, tier, sessionId}
tolerance_bands_source: Cpk from AS9100 / Six Sigma standard; MAPE bands from manufacturing-AI literature (Tooluxe, MachiningCloud); S(x) tiers from PRISM tiered-omega doctrine in state/shared/omega-thresholds.json; kinematic dexterity from Yoshikawa 1985.
v3_1_resolves: Pass-3 risk-hunter finding 4/5: 'Omega=1.0 undefined for continuous metrics; testers will round or block forever.' This file defines the semantics.
